newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Eight people killed in Ukraine gas explosion.
newsitem.headline: Eight people killed in Ukraine gas explosion.

text.p: Eight people were killed in an early morning gas explosion that destroyed four storeys of a residential building in eastern Ukraine on Tuesday, a government official said.
Officials said four people were killed outright in the explosion which occurred in the city of Melitopol. Four others died in hospital from their injuries.
Emergency Ministry spokesman Oleh Bykov told Reuters that workers were continuing to search through the rubble for bodies.

Preliminary investigations blamed the explosion on a build-up of gas, a common occurrence in former Soviet republics where gas is used for central heating and to fuel ovens, and buildings are poorly constructed.
